question: Fed decreases interest rates by 25 bps after October 2026 meeting?
description: This market will resolve to "Yes" if the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is decreased by 25 bps at the October 2026 FOMC meeting. The resolution source is the FOMC statement. If no statement is released by November 15, 2026, this market resolves to "No".

events.title: Fed decreases interest rates by 25 bps after October 2026 meeting?

question: Fed decreases interest rates by 50+ bps after October 2026 meeting?
description: Resolves Yes if rates are decreased by 50 or more bps at the October 2026 FOMC meeting.

events.title: Fed decreases interest rates by 50+ bps after October 2026 meeting?

question: Chiefs vs. Bills
description: In the upcoming NFL game scheduled for October 12, 2026, if the Kansas City Chiefs win, this market resolves to "Chiefs". If the game is postponed past October 19, 2026 or ends in a tie, this market resolves 50-50.

question: Will Jane Doe win the 2026 Ohio Senate election?
description: This market will resolve to "Yes" if Jane Doe wins the 2026 US Senate election in Ohio, per Associated Press, Fox News and NBC calls. Otherwise "No".

question: Will September 2026 CPI be above 3.0%?
